title: Edit nonconformance
purpose: Revise current issue details while retaining the earlier values and reason in the timeline.
summary: Revise a nonconformance's current details. The earlier values and your reason are kept in the timeline. Only the owner or a lead can edit.

tasks.title: Correct the details
steps: Change the title, classification, owner, due date, links or findings.
Explain why in [[Reason]] and select [[Save changes]].

tasks.title: Clarify the original description
steps: Go back to the record and select [[Add note or evidence]]. The original description cannot be edited.

good_to_know: A closed issue must be reopened before it can be edited.
An existing link can be replaced but not removed. Leaving it blank keeps it.
Once investigation has started, the owner cannot be cleared.
Saving does not move the issue to its next step, and a save with no changes is refused.

sections.title: Who can change this record
paragraphs: Any lab staff member can open a nonconformance, read it and add notes/evidence, including after closure. Only its assigned owner or an admin, reviewer, approver or project manager role can edit details or drive workflow. Opening a record does not by itself give the opener management rights. Staff selectors list active non-client accounts, ordered by username, with full name and username when available.

sections.title: Eligibility
paragraphs: Record must not be Closed; reopen before editing a closed issue. Title, assignment, classifications, links and selected findings can change. Original description/discovery, opened identity, verification and closure are not fields on this form. A save with no actual changes is refused.

items.label: Category
items.description: Required: Sample, Batch / QC, Equipment, Standard / reagent, Personnel / training, Procedure / documentation or Other.

items.label: Severity
items.description: Required: Minor, Major or Critical; the application does not assign thresholds for these choices.

items.label: Owner
items.description: Optional only while Open. Once investigation has started the owner cannot be cleared; replacement must be an active non-client account.

items.label: Due
items.description: Optional entered target date; may be cleared. Unlike creation, this edit does not check due date against discovery.

items.label: Sample
items.description: Optional existing laboratory sample ID, maximum 32 characters; case-insensitive match.

items.label: Analytical batch
items.description: Optional existing batch number, for example B-000123 or 123, maximum 20 characters.

items.label: Standard / reagent lot
items.description: Optional lot, including retired/expired lots, ordered by material name then lot number and labelled with both.

items.label: Equipment
items.description: Optional registered asset, including retired assets. Links are independent: there is no automatic category match or requirement to link at least one record. Multiple record types can be linked.

sections.title: Link corrections
paragraphs: An existing link can be replaced by another valid record but cannot be removed: leaving the field blank preserves the existing link. An unlinked field can remain blank or acquire a link. The form does not automatically align category or one link with another.

items.label: Disposition
items.description: Optional Not decided or Continue work, no effect on results; Continue work, qualify results; Repeat or re-prepare work; Hold work pending decision; Reject or discard affected work; Other (explain in the note).

items.label: Disposition note
items.description: Optional explanation, particularly for Other. The later root-cause step requires it for Other.

items.label: Root cause
items.description: Optional current cause text; later workflow checks require it before Corrective action.

items.label: Corrective action
items.description: Optional current action text; later checks require it before Verification.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required account of why the details changed; earlier/later values and this reason stay in the timeline.

sections.title: Save changes
paragraphs: Updates current details and adds Details updated to the timeline without advancing status. Clearing findings is allowed here even in later nonclosed states; required content is checked by the corresponding forward step.

sections.title: Saving and errors
paragraphs: An asterisk marks required fields. Cancel returns to the parent record or list without saving. Success opens the saved record with a confirmation. Validation errors appear above the form and beside affected fields; correct them and submit again. Text input remains after validation errors; select an evidence file again if necessary. Dates use year-month-day; date and time fields use the deployment time zone.

sections.title: Concurrent changes and history
paragraphs: Saving locks and rechecks the revision you opened. If another user changed the record, reload it, review the latest values and enter your change again. Failed validation writes no partial change. Successful changes and attributed audit events commit together.

sections.title: Workflow and limits
paragraphs: The fixed flow is Open, Investigating, Corrective action, Verification, Closed. Steps cannot be skipped. Verification can return to Corrective action; Closed can reopen to Investigating, each with a reason. Severity and disposition are recorded choices; the system does not infer them. A linked issue or a disposition such as Hold or Qualify does not automatically hold a batch, qualify a result, retire equipment, alter stock or block report release. Apply any separate operational controls explicitly. There is no required independent verifier rule in this workflow; the owner or lead can verify and close.

sections.title: Form dialog controls
paragraphs: With enhancement enabled, the form opens in a dialog, including when its URL is opened directly. Without enhancement it remains a normal page. While loading or saving, controls are disabled to avoid duplicate submissions; focus moves to the first invalid field or first editable field when ready. Saving successfully navigates to the resulting record.

items.label: Maximize / Restore size
items.description: Expand the dialog to full screen or restore its normal size. Small screens use a full-screen layout.

items.label: Cancel / Close form / Escape
items.description: Close an unchanged form. When opened over another page, return focus to its opening control; when opened directly, return to the Cancel destination. Clicking outside the dialog does not close it.

items.label: Keep editing / Discard changes
items.description: After an input change, attempting to leave asks Discard your unsaved changes? Keep editing retains the form; Discard changes closes or follows the requested destination without saving. Escape during that prompt keeps editing.

items.label: Try again
items.description: Shown after a failed initial load. Retry loading the form. Save/connection errors keep the current input and show an error so you can retry the submission. Validation errors replace the form with its submitted values and field messages; files may need selecting again.
